'''Frontier Inn''' was a building in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]] on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. A large [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] marquee stated the name of the establishment. Another marquee on top of the building simply said "inn".
